newsitem.title: PERU: Lima stock exchange extends trading hours.
newsitem.headline: Lima stock exchange extends trading hours.

text.p: The Lima Stock Exchange said it began from Monday operating new extended trading hours in line with international markets.

The market will now operate "winter" trading hours of 0900 to 1700 local time (1400 to 2200 GMT) between October and June, and a "summer" timetable of 0800 to 1600 (1300 to 2100 GMT) between July and September.
The bolsa was previously opening for trade between 0900 and 1300 local time (1400 and 1800 GMT).
